text:
Predicates:
Engaged(x) ::: x is engaged
Invite(x, y) ::: x invites y to their wedding
MakeWeddingPlans(x) ::: x makes wedding plans
WellAttended(x) ::: x has a well-attended wedding
LargerFamily(x) ::: x has a larger family
John ::: John

Premises:
∀x (MakeWeddingPlans(x) → Engaged(x)) ::: All people who make wedding plans are engaged
∀x (Invite(x, y) → MakeWeddingPlans(x)) ::: All people who invite others to their wedding make wedding plans
∀x (WellAttended(x) → Invite(x, y)) ::: Anyone with a well-attended wedding invites others
∀x (LargerFamily(x) → (WellAttended(x) ∨ Invite(x, y))) ::: If someone has a larger family, they have a well-attended wedding or invite others
Engaged(John) → ¬Invite(John, y) ∧ ¬MakeWeddingPlans(John) ::: If John is engaged, then he does not invite friends and does not make wedding plans
LargerFamily(John) → (WellAttended(John) ∨ Invite(John, y)) ::: If John has a larger family, then he has a well-attended wedding or invites others

Conclusion:
¬LargerFamily(John) ∧ ¬Invite(John, y) ::: John neither has a larger family nor invites others
